en.headline: Police arrest nine over guess-who phone scams targeting elderly, recover all funds
en.dek: West Kowloon officers dismantled a syndicate in an operation from mid-October to 4 November, seizing phones after six victims aged 73 to 86 lost about HK$325,000.
body: Police have arrested nine people on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud in connection with “guess who I am” telephone scams that targeted elderly residents, and recovered all the money taken.

West Kowloon Regional Crime Unit officers, noting a rise in such cases, conducted an operation codenamed Flash Raid from 15 October to 4 November. They arrested five runners and two monitors as victims prepared to hand over cash, then detained two core members in Tsuen Wan and Cheung Sha Wan. The nine suspects, seven men and two women aged 16 to 42, include five local residents and four two-way permit holders.

Six victims aged 73 to 86 lost between about HK$25,000 and HK$90,000 each, totalling roughly HK$325,000. Police said the entire sum was recovered. Officers seized mobile phones and clothing at the suspects’ homes.

Police said the group was managed by a local core member who recruited runners, some from the mainland, and held their identity documents while issuing work phones. The public, especially older people, were urged to verify callers with family and to contact the Anti-Scam Helpline.

zh.headline: 警方破「猜猜我是誰」電騙集團 拘9人起回全數逾32萬元
zh.dek: 西九龍總區10月中至11月4日行動，針對6名73至86歲長者，損失約32.5萬元已全數追回。
body: 警方以涉嫌串謀詐騙拘9人，涉及針對長者的「猜猜我是誰」電話騙案，並已起回全部騙款。
西九龍總區刑事部留意到相關騙案有上升趨勢，於10月15日至11月4日展開代號「閃襲」行動。人員在受害人準備交款時拘5名跑腿及2名監察員，其後在荃灣及長沙灣拘捕兩名骨幹成員。9名被捕人為7男2女、16至42歲，包括5名本地人及4名持雙程證人士。
6名73至86歲受害人每人損失約2.5萬至9萬元，總額約32.5萬元。警方表示全部款項已追回，並在住所檢獲電話及衣物。
警方指集團由本地骨幹成員管理，招聘跑腿並扣留其身份證件、派發工作電話。當局呼籲市民尤其長者核實來電者身份，並可致電防騙易熱線。
